title: max()-based resume point skips unprocessed rows
expected_feedback: Standard: two backfill defects. (1) max(id) WHERE total_usd IS NOT NULL as a resume point skips every unprocessed row below the maximum -- which happens with parallel workers, a retried batch, or rows where the computation legitimately yields NULL. Use min(id) WHERE total_usd IS NULL, or persist the cursor in the batch's own transaction. (2) OFFSET rescans skipped rows, making the backfill O(n^2); advance a keyset cursor instead. Run ANALYZE afterwards.
violated_rule: keyset batching and a resume point that cannot skip rows
